The Eticas taxonomy maps four IEEE standards at category level: 

1. IEEE Std 7001-2021 - covers transparency of autonomous systems.
2. IEEE Std 7002-2022 - covers data privacy process.
3. IEEE Std 7003-2024 - covers algorithmic bias considerations.
4. IEEE Std 2894-2024 - serves as an advisory framework for explainable AI. 

These standards are placed in the compliance tier and are mapped to relevant domains within the taxonomy.
